quest.title: Ellin, the Wannabe Knight
quest.description: Ellin is working hard to become a knight, but her training doesn't seem to work out. She seems to need some guidance...

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Ugh, what a headache... What am I supposed to do about this?

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Practicing for the Knights of Favonius' tryouts!

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: *sigh* But I'm nowhere near as powerful as Jean.

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: I think it's better for me to focus on technique rather than power.

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: For example, I was thinking about how to break all these wooden dummies in one fell swoop.

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: They're a lot more robust than they look, this is no trivial task... I don't know where my father managed to get them from, but he must have gone to a lot of effort.

talks.objective: Destroy all the training dummies in under 2 seconds

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: How are you getting along? Had a eureka moment yet?

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Huh. I've met a few other Adventurers before. They were the same way.

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: They fight monsters like pros, but they're hopelessly lost when it comes to trying to break a few wooden sticks.

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: And they reinforce the wood like it's for building a storm shelter or something... Way overestimating their own strength.

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: If they want a challenge so desperately, why don't they just go off into the wilderness and pick a fight with the biggest monster they can find?

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Huh, I never even thought of trying that...

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Thanks! I'm gonna try it myself now.
